Organization describes college and career readiness programs for students, consistent with OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' category and a High School Linked Learning Office contract
MISMATCH: registry and website give Walnut, CA (Los Angeles County), while the agenda says Walnut Creek, CA; no page found mentions Oakland, OUSD or the Bay Area
research.notes: Name matches exactly, but the agenda lists Walnut Creek, CA (Contra Costa County) while the registered nonprofit is in Walnut, CA (Los Angeles County). This may be an agenda typo or a different organization; no page found links NCRF to Oakland or OUSD. Web search budget was exhausted, so no independent confirmation was possible. Needs human review before publishing.

profile.summary: A nonprofit educational organization based in Walnut, California. It runs college expos, college tours, STEAM (science, technology, engineering, arts and math) events and camps, and career and internship programs aimed at underserved students.
